contact.heading: Contact Us
contact.text:
Email: support@mathhelper.al
We respond within 24 hours on business days.

faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.text:
How to start a course?
Go to the "Learn" tab, choose a course and click "Start Course".

How to take a quiz?
Go to the "Quiz" tab, choose a quiz and click "Start Quiz".

How to save a problem?
After AI analysis, click "Save Problem" to save it.

bug.heading: Report a Problem
bug.text: If you find any bugs, please send us an email with the problem description and app version.

acceptance.heading: 1. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.text: By using MathHelper, you accept the following terms. If you do not accept, do not use the application.

service.heading: 2. The Service
service.text: MathHelper provides math lessons, interactive quizzes, and AI-powered problem analysis for educational purposes.

accounts.heading: 3. Accounts
accounts.text: You are responsible for the security of your account. Do not share your password with others.

liability.heading: 4. Limitation of Liability
liability.text: MathHelper does not guarantee absolute accuracy of AI solutions. Always verify with your teacher.

changes.heading: 5. Changes
changes.text: We may change the terms of service at any time. Notifications are sent by email.

dataCollected.heading: 1. Data Collected
dataCollected.text: We collect: name, email, and learning activity (courses completed, quizzes taken, problems solved).

dataUsage.heading: 2. Data Usage
dataUsage.text: Data is used solely to provide you the service and to improve the application.

security.heading: 3. Security
security.text: Data is stored locally on your device. We do not share it with third parties.

deletion.heading: 4. Deletion
deletion.text: You can delete your account and all data by contacting support@mathhelper.al

mission.heading: Our Mission
mission.text: MathHelper aims to make mathematics accessible and understandable for everyone. With clear explanations, practical examples and AI analysis, we help you reach your mathematical potential.

features.heading: Features
features.text:
• 52 math courses
• Interactive quizzes
• Problem analysis with Google Gemini AI
• Progress tracking
• Achievement system

developer.heading: Developer
developer.text:

AI: Google Gemini
